dict.string: Copyright © 2026 DreamOfXM · Apache-2.0 Menu-bar panel + alert layer. Reads the session logs each CLI writes on this machine to tell who is running and who is waiting; no network, no upload, no credentials read. Falls back to a sound when the banner channel is unavailable. Ledger and settings live in AgentPing's state dir (macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/AgentPing; Linux: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/AgentPing). 读本机各 CLI 自己写的会话日志判状态；不联网、不上传、不读凭据。横幅不可用时退化成提示音。去重账本与设置落在 AgentPing 的状态目录。
